scenario: A tea vendor defuses a knife fight by naming every combatant's preferred tea.
narrative_intent: Briefly distract nearby people with an embarrassingly specific scent.
guardrails: No condition is imposed.
A hostile creature can ignore the scent.

scenario: A baker catches a falling child with a loaf that swells at the last moment.
narrative_intent: Reduce one instance of minor falling harm through improvised baking.
guardrails: Cannot negate a lethal fall.
Requires carried baking supplies.

scenario: A sewer singer learns which tunnel rats are agitated before entering.
narrative_intent: Gain a vague clue about nearby vermin activity.
guardrails: Does not control animals.
The clue can be incomplete or misleading.

scenario: A dockworker rolls a dense keg that knocks a smuggler away from the pier edge.
narrative_intent: Forced movement using a prepared heavy object.
guardrails: Requires a heavy object and clear path.
No damage beyond the anchor's low-rank envelope.

scenario: A chimney sweep skims across roof tiles to cross a narrow gap.
narrative_intent: A short burst of rooftop movement.
guardrails: Requires a broom and stable takeoff.
Cannot grant sustained flight.

scenario: A cook stirs a soup reflection into a temporary passage through one pantry wall.
narrative_intent: Pass through a thin nonmagical barrier.
guardrails: Cannot cross load-bearing or magical barriers.
Closes before a second creature can use it.

scenario: A tailor snaps an electrified quilt around an ally to deter a pursuer.
narrative_intent: A reactive short-range burst around one ally.
guardrails: Only functions after the ally is targeted.
Does not grant a lasting shield bonus.

scenario: An eccentric auditor makes a skeleton stop and count its own missing fingers.
narrative_intent: Briefly disrupt an undead enemy through a knowledge-based curse.

mechanics.duration: one round on a failed save

guardrails: Only affects undead.
A successful save has no action-denial effect.

scenario: A chef serves broth that lets allies coordinate an escape with startling precision.
narrative_intent: Briefly improve party mobility without granting extra turns.
guardrails: The added action can only be used for movement.
Cannot affect more targets without higher-level scaling.

scenario: A courtroom musician repeats a lie until it becomes audibly discordant.
narrative_intent: Expose a contradiction in spoken testimony.
guardrails: Does not read thoughts.
The target can remain silent.

scenario: A messenger marks a city map and their boots remember every alley between two points.
narrative_intent: Traverse familiar urban terrain unusually quickly.
guardrails: Only works in a mapped settlement.
Does not bypass sealed doors or vertical flight limits.

scenario: An orchard keeper calls lightning into a line of metal harvest poles.
narrative_intent: A prepared line-area electrical attack.
guardrails: Requires prepared conductive poles.
Cannot be used as an unprepared wide-area attack.

scenario: A glassblower turns a courtyard reflection into a deceptive moat.
narrative_intent: Create a battlefield illusion that impedes only creatures that believe it.
guardrails: Does not create real water or cover.
Disbelief interacts with the effect under normal illusion rules.

scenario: A postal courier folds a letter into a tiny paper drake that carries one message through danger.
narrative_intent: Deliver a small object with limited autonomy.
guardrails: The drake cannot attack or scout indefinitely.
It cannot cross planar boundaries.

scenario: A librarian summons the ghost of a whale that remembers drowned books.
narrative_intent: Ask a limited number of questions about a lost text.
guardrails: Answers are incomplete and bounded by the site's history.
Cannot reveal future events.

scenario: A festival engineer reverses gravity in a single pavilion after ringing its emergency bell.
narrative_intent: A rare, prepared battlefield transformation.
guardrails: Requires a constructed venue and emergency bell.
Never available as an ordinary repeatable combat option.

scenario: A cartographer burns a star map to open a view onto every road they have personally walked.
narrative_intent: A narrative travel-and-information milestone ability.
guardrails: Requires destruction of a hand-drawn map.
Cannot transport creatures or reveal an unknown location.

scenario: A sea judge summons spectral jurors from the tide to bind a treaty-breaker.
narrative_intent: A unique social consequence that becomes a combat restraint only after a proven betrayal.
guardrails: Requires a witnessed broken oath.
Cannot adjudicate ordinary disagreements or compel testimony.

scenario: A lighthouse keeper releases a stored dawn to clear an island fogbank and harm shadow creatures.
narrative_intent: A once-per-arc environmental purification effect.
guardrails: Requires a lighthouse charged through a full night.
The environmental change is local and temporary.

scenario: A bridge keeper asks the names carved into its foundation to carry refugees across a chasm.
narrative_intent: A capstone evacuation ability rather than an attack.
guardrails: Only crosses to a named endpoint connected by the bridge's history.
Requires a major narrative milestone and cannot be used repeatedly.

scenario: A chef feeds a starving lunar spirit and turns an eclipse into a harmless theatrical night.
narrative_intent: A world-flavored but locally bounded environmental resolution.
guardrails: Cannot alter celestial bodies or global weather.
Requires a unique spirit, ritual feast, and GM milestone.

scenario: A candle-maker wants wax animals to trap an enemy in a burning cathedral.
narrative_intent: Summon small wax animals for battlefield interference.
guardrails: The animals cannot out-damage a comparable rank-1 summon.
They cannot create permanent restraints.

scenario: A salt miner throws a fistful of salt to reveal an invisible assassin.
narrative_intent: Temporarily counter a concealed threat.
guardrails: Does not reveal creatures outside the burst.
Does not defeat every form of invisibility automatically.

scenario: A picnic champion makes an ogre too polite to attack while eating a ceremonial sandwich.
narrative_intent: Create a short nonviolent window through an offered meal.
guardrails: The target can still defend itself.
Hostile acts end the truce.

scenario: A conductor makes a moving train forget one occupied carriage exists.
narrative_intent: Hide a limited group during a chase.
guardrails: Does not make the carriage intangible.
Observers can still notice physical consequences.

scenario: A volcanic postmaster launches a sealed parcel through a caldera to an ally beyond a siege.
narrative_intent: Move one small object through a dangerous but known route.
guardrails: Cannot move creatures.
The destination must be known and unoccupied.

scenario: A war drummer conducts a marching band whose rhythm lets allies ignore a dragon's terrifying roar.
narrative_intent: Temporarily support allies against fear effects.
guardrails: Does not grant immunity to all mental effects.
Requires audible performance.

scenario: A gardener grows a cloud hedge that catches falling airships for one dramatic rescue.
narrative_intent: A milestone rescue that prevents a catastrophic fall in one scene.
guardrails: Requires a prepared sky garden and a rescue scene.
Cannot create a permanent floating fortress.

scenario: A storm thief catches a monarch's lightning and returns it as a judgment against an invading army.
narrative_intent: A rare counterattack against a large supernatural assault.
guardrails: Only triggers after absorbing a qualifying lightning effect.
Cannot be initiated without that trigger.

scenario: A librarian awakens an ocean of ink that swallows a forbidden archive without harming the town around it.
narrative_intent: A precise capstone containment effect.
guardrails: Only affects the named archive.
Requires the archive's true catalog and a major narrative cost.

scenario: An innkeeper opens every room of a ruined inn to shelter survivors from a planar storm.
narrative_intent: A world-category refuge ability with no direct combat use.
guardrails: Requires the original inn's ruins and a campaign finale milestone.
Cannot summon hostile creatures or solve unrelated encounters.
